metadata.source: Borough of Glen Rock & Glen Rock BOE Approved Bill Lists (CY 2025–2026)

vendors.name: Bergen Municipal Employee Benefits Fund (BMED)
vendors.description: Comprehensive medical and prescription drug coverage for unionized public employees after exiting SHBP to curb double-digit premium increases.

vendors.name: South Bergen Jointure Commission
vendors.description: Specialized tuition, behaviorist therapies, and coordinated out-of-district student transportation for special needs learners.

vendors.name: Public Service Electric & Gas (PSE&G)
vendors.description: Electricity and natural gas supply, high school athletic field illumination, and town hall heating.

vendors.name: Lerch, Vinci & Bliss, LLP
vendors.description: Annual independent statutory municipal financial audit and Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) preparation.

vendors.name: Fogarty & Hara, Esqs.
vendors.description: Board of Education legal representation for collective bargaining negotiations, special education IEP litigation, and state policy compliance.

vendors.name: Boswell Engineering
vendors.description: Design and inspection of annual municipal road resurfacing, stormwater culverts, and Diamond Brook flood mitigation.

vendors.name: Downes Tree Service Inc.
vendors.description: Hazardous shade tree pruning, emerald ash borer tree removals, and emergency storm branch clearance.
